metadata.description: Free Claude Code plugins: Terse for shorter answers, Session Board Lite for splitting a big job into parallel sessions.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Shorter Claude answers: the answer first, no preamble, recap or closing offer, and the AI writing tells stripped from the words that stay.

plugins.name: session-board-lite
plugins.description: Split one big job into Claude Code sessions and build a local board with one paste-ready card per session.
